name: orders-api
description: Example API: a GraphQL subgraph that stores orders in PostgreSQL. With an oidc provider it asks every request for a token that carries the client role orders:read (queries) or orders:write (mutations), which the provider gives to the services that say they use it (D22). Its source is apis/orders-api; build the image with: docker build -t ghcr.io/rudney5000/plugbricks/orders-api:0.1.1 apis/orders-api
